subject: Orbit Consulting — Redwood sandbox enablement & joint delivery checklist
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha@orbitconsulting.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: partner-success@orbitconsulting.com
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership kickoff — Redwood sandbox request and technical intake

Hi Karthik and Laura,

Thanks again for the intro last week — Orbit Consulting is excited to get our first co-delivery pilot set up. To accelerate the initial enablement work we wanted to request: 

1) Short-lived sandbox access for a single project (dev credentials + example model variant)
2) A 90-minute technical walkthrough with your partner enablement team (we'll invite engineering + solutions)
3) Any partner-focused starter kit (playbook, runbook, or sample prompts) you can share so we can prep our internal delivery squad

I've attached a one-pager that outlines our pilot goals and the stakeholders who will be involved (Orbit_QuickStart.pdf). High-level timeline we have in mind: 2–3 week discovery, then a 6–8 week pilot with a joint demo to our client.

Primary contacts from our side: 
- Asha Menon (me) — Partner lead
- Mateo Ruiz <mateo.ruiz@orbitconsulting.com> — Solutions lead

Questions for you: any onboarding docs or compliance checklists we should complete before you can provision sandbox access? Also, do you have a standard SOW template for SI co-deliveries?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call this week if that helps.

Best,
Asha Menon
Partner Lead, Orbit Consulting
asha@orbitconsulting.com

Attachments: Orbit_QuickStart.pdf (1 page summary)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@orbitconsulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership kickoff — Redwood sandbox request and technical intake

Hi Asha — great to hear from you and thanks for the one-pager. We're excited to partner with Orbit on this pilot. 

Short answers up front: yes, we can provision a sandbox, and we have a compact partner starter kit and an SI SOW template. I want to confirm a couple details so we provision the right environment: 
- Target model family (open vs. Redwood-verified): which is preferred for pilot? If you want lowest latency & simplest onboarding, we recommend Redwood-verified medium model variant.
- Data handling: will you be uploading client sample data into the sandbox or only using synthetic/test prompts?

Proposed next steps (from our side):
1) I will kick off a sandbox request — give us 48hrs to spin up a dev project and keys.
2) Laura (cc'd) will schedule a 90-minute walkthrough next week; she'll share the partner starter kit and the SOW template.
3) Rishi will scope a light security questionnaire we typically require for SI pilots and flag anything that requires legal review.

Would Fri 4/5 at 10:30am PT work for the walkthrough? If so, Laura will send a calendar invite.

Karthik
Head of Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Asha
